manual:
Clears registered run-scoped data as soon as a game reset is detected - a new game, BitNode destruction, or augmentation install. Current snapshots will normally self-heal on their next write, but history, running totals, and carry-over state would otherwise describe a run that no longer exists.

The public dashboard contributes its own reset paths. Any separately installed source may add a JSON manifest under dashboard/reset-files/, so this service remains standalone while optional integrations clean up their own data. The Additional Reset Files option is only for a local run-scoped file whose owner has not yet supplied a manifest. Dashboard options, the deployment manifest, and File Shredder's own reset marker are always protected.
